page.overview:
Who is Octoboss?

Octoboss is a mutated Squidmen and supervillain. He is a minor antagonist in Season 2.

Nothing is known about Octoboss' history, all that is known is that unlike other members of his species, Octoboss was born with pink skin and grew to surpass the average size for Squidmen. Prior to the events of the show, he would take on a life of crime and become known as the supervillain "Octoboss".

Octoboss is seen with other Squidmen, hijacking a facility for highly radioactive resources, where he is greeted by Rex Splode. The two fight it out, with Octoboss gaining the upper hand due to his strength and Rex having recently recovered from an injury. Unfortunately for him, Invincible would come in to help Rex. Octoboss would eventually get defeated by Rex by his new arm implant.

Octoboss, much like other members of his species, appears as a humanoid male octopus with red eyes, no hair, and tentacles sprouting from his arms. Unlike other Squidmen, his size far surpasses the average size of his species, along with his coloring being pink rather the regular dark cyan his species are. He also possesses metal leggings to theoretically get around easier, as well as an arm cannon to deal stronger damage.
